<a id="page-forms"></a>
# Controls and forms

Buttons, inputs, toggles, choices, pickers, chips, and forms that validate. Open it when a UI takes input, or a
control needs a key beyond its text and its `@name`.

<a id="forms-a-control-and-its-value"></a>
## A control and its value

`@name` keeps a control's value in a variable, both ways; declare it with `state`. `onChange={…}` runs when
the value changes (`result` is the new value). `enabled={…}` turns a control off.

```notation
state email=""
state agree=false
Column gap=12
  Input "Email" @email keyboardType=emailAddress
  Checkbox "I agree" @agree
  Button "Send" enabled={agree} onTap={emit send}
```

```notation
state size="M"
state volume=0
Column gap=12
  Select @size items=["S","M","L"]
  Slider @volume min=0 max=100
```

Words a writer reaches for, and what they read as:

- `RangeSlider @low end=@high min=0 max=90` is `Slider @low @high min=0 max=90`, a slider with two thumbs.
- `semanticLabel="Wi-Fi"` on a Toggle, Checkbox, Radio or Slider is the name a screen reader says, not shown (a
  `label` is drawn beside it).
- `Input "Search" prefixIcon="search"` is `icon="search"`: the icon inside the field.

```notation expands
state code=""
state low=20
state high=80
state plan="month"
Column gap=12
  Input "Password" password
  Input "Note" multiline
  CodeInput "Code" @code length=6 digits
  Slider @low @high min=0 max=100
  SegmentedButton @plan items=["month","year"]
```

It reads as:

```notation
state code=""
state low=20
state high=80
state plan="month"
Column gap=12
  Input "Password" password
  Input "Note" minLines=3 maxLines=6
  Input "Code" @code otpLength=6 otpDigitsOnly=true
  Slider @low @high min=0 max=100
  SegmentedButton @plan segments=[{"value":"month","label":"month"},{"value":"year","label":"year"}]
```

<a id="forms-tabs-segments-and-chips-chosen-from"></a>
## Tabs, segments and chips chosen from

What is chosen among a few takes the theme's accent with nothing styled, on a white page as on a cream one, in dark
as in light: a `TabBar`'s or `Tabs`' chosen label and its line are the accent (the ink where the accent does not
read on the page); a `SegmentedButton`'s chosen segment and a chosen `ChoiceChip` or `FilterChip` are filled with
the accent, their label in its ink (`onPrimary`). What is not chosen is a tint of the theme's ink over what it sits
on, never a fixed grey. Chips and segments are rounded rectangles (the theme's control radius, at every width), not
pills, and a chosen chip shows no check mark unless the line writes `showCheckmark=true`. A row of chips is the word
for filters and for tabs across a page: write `ChoiceChip "All stories" selected={section=="All"} onTap={…}` and do
not style it. The line's own colors (`selectedColor=`, `backgroundColor=`, the label's `labelStyle.color=`) and `shape=` win.

<a id="forms-a-number-with-its-buttons"></a>
## A number with its buttons

`NumberInput @seats min=1 max=500` is a number field with a minus button before the number and a plus button after
it, all inside the field's one border, a rule between each part: a press steps the number by `step=` (1) within
`min=` and `max=`, and a button at its bound is drawn disabled and takes no press. Focused, Up and Down step it too,
Page Up and Page Down ten steps, Home and End go to the bounds. It is as high as the other inputs (a fixed `h=`
picks another step of the control scale) and 112 wide unless it says. `Input … keyboardType=number steppers=true`
is the same field; a design system's own `NumberInput` comes first.

```notation expands
state seats=48
Row gap=12
  NumberInput @seats min=45 max=500 semanticLabel="Seats"
  Text "{seats} seats"
```

It reads as:

```notation
state seats=48
Row gap=12
  Input w=112 @seats min=45 max=500 semanticLabel=Seats keyboardType=number steppers=true textAlign=center
  Text "{seats} seats"
```

A field of your own between two buttons looks whole when the border is the Row's: `Row border=… radius=6
clip=antiAlias` around `IconButton "remove" border-right=…`, `Input … decoration.border.type=none` and
`IconButton "add" border-left=…`. A box's border is drawn over what it holds, so the field's fill never covers it.

<a id="forms-validation"></a>
## Validation

A column with `form=true` holds fields that check themselves: an Input's `validator={…}` gives the message (empty when
the value is good), and the `validate` action checks every field of the form; `result` says whether all passed.

```notation expands
state email=""
Column#signup gap=12 form=true
  Input "Email" @email validator={email == "" ? "Required" : ""}
  Button "Send" onTap={validate node=signup}
```

It reads as:

```notation
state email=""
Column#signup gap=12 form=true
  Input "Email" @email validator={email == "" ? "Required" : ""}
  Button "Send" onTap={validate node=signup}
```

A whole form: each field's rule, the messages shown once a field is left (`form.autovalidateMode=onUnfocus`, a
key of the form's record), a count of what is wrong read from `form.errors` (each error's `label` and `message`),
and a send that goes on only when every field passes (`result ? … : …`).

```notation
state name=""
state email=""
state sent=false
Column#signup gap=12 form.autovalidateMode=onUnfocus
  Input "Name" @name validator={trim(name) == '' ? 'Enter your name.' : ''}
  Input "Email" @email validator={matches(email, '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+$') ? '' : 'Enter an email like name@example.com.'} keyboardType=emailAddress
  Text "{length(form.errors)} fields need attention" color=#FFDC2626 visible={length(form.errors) > 0}
  Button "Send" onTap={validate node=signup; result ? sent=true : toast "Check the form"}
  Text "Thanks, {name}!" visible={sent}
```

<a id="forms-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-filledButton"></a>
### `Button` (`filledButton`)

Flutter `FilledButton`: the primary action, filled with the theme's `primary`. With nothing styled it is the default (SSUI) button on the control scale: 28 high when it hugs, its padding, font and icon sizes from its height (24, 28, 32, 36, 44). A bound "selected" shows a selected look.

- Written `Button`; also `Button.primary`, `Button.secondary`, `Button.tertiary`, `Button.destructive`. Level 1 (Widget catalog).
- `Button "…"` sets `props.label`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | `""` | 1 | The button's text (not `text`). Its color, size and weight are in `style`. |
| `textAlign` | `left` `right` `center` `justify` `start` `end` | `start` | 1 |  |
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` | 1 | The icon beside the label; empty for none. |
| `iconAlignment` | `start` `end` | `start` | 1 |  |
| `gap` (or `spacing`) | number (≥ 0) | `8` | 1 | Space between the icon and the label. |
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 1 | False is a disabled button (`onPressed: null`). |
| `style` | [ButtonStyle](#type-ButtonStyle) | `{}` | 1 | The button's look (Flutter's `ButtonStyle`): `backgroundColor`, `foregroundColor` (the label and icon), `textStyle`, `shape`, `side`, `padding`. A button's colors are here, not in `decoration`. |
| `autofocus` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 1 | Takes keyboard focus when it appears (Flutter's `autofocus`): Enter or Space presses it. |
| `loading` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 1 | Busy (SSUI's `isLoading`; no Flutter counterpart): a spinner in place of the icon, taps ignored, drawn as disabled, announced as busy. Bind it to the state an action sets while it runs. |
| `tonal` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 1 | `FilledButton.tonal`. |

<a id="node-textField"></a>
### `Input` (`textField`)

Flutter `TextField`. Leave its height to hug: every input (text field, dropdown, date and time picker) is then the same control height (28); a fixed height picks another step of the control scale (24, 28, 32, 36, 44) and should be the same on the inputs beside it.

- Written `Input`; also `CodeInput`, `NumberInput`. Level 1 (Widget catalog).
- `Input "…"` sets `props.decoration.labelText`; a second string sets `props.decoration.hintText`.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): the field's own box: `fill=#FFF3F4F6` its fill, `border=#FFD1D5DB` its line (`border=none`: none, and no fill unless one is written: a bare field), `radius=20` its corners; else only `effects` (blurs).
- In a row beside buttons a multi-line `Input` is a composer: it starts at one line and grows (to `maxLines`), and its string is its placeholder (beside a hint, its spoken name); a field among icon buttons has no label above it either, nor one field beside a text button (an entry: `Input "Add an item" @item grow` before `Button "Add"`; not the row that ends a form, a field with a label and a hint after the form's other fields, whose label stays; `label="…"` keeps one anywhere), and one beside a button in a framed row (`Box radius=12 border` around a `Row` of it and its buttons) is drawn bare. A search field (`Input "Search…"`, also `Find…`, `Filter…`, or a field in a top bar whose text or id says search) has the magnifier before its text (`icon="search"`) unless it writes its own icon (`icon=none`: none). A multi-line field with `onSubmit` sends on Enter and breaks the line on Shift+Enter (`textInputAction=send`).
- The fields of its text style ([TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle)) are keys by their own names: `letterSpacing=0.4`, `fontFamily="Inter"`.

| `decoration` | [InputDecoration](#type-InputDecoration) | `{}` | 1 | The field's label, hint, helper and error texts, border (per state), fill, padding and icons (Flutter's `InputDecoration`). |
| `style` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | 1 | The typed text's style; unset is the theme's. |
| `textAlign` | `left` `right` `center` `justify` `start` `end` | `start` | 1 |  |

<a id="forms-behaviors"></a>
## Keys any line takes here

<a id="behavior-form"></a>
### `form` (behavior)

Flutter's Form: the text fields inside validate together (the validate action); its nodes read ${form.valid} and ${form.errors}.

Written `form={…}` on any line ([FormBehavior](#type-FormBehavior)). Level 1.
 Each field of its record (FormBehavior) is a key of its own, dotted: `form.autovalidateMode=…`.

<a id="type-FormBehavior"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `form.autovalidateMode` | `disabled` `always` `onUserInteraction` `onUnfocus` `onUserInteractionIfError` | `disabled` | When every field inside checks itself, besides the validate action (Flutter's Form.autovalidateMode). |

<a id="behavior-radioGroup"></a>
### `radioGroup` (behavior)

Flutter's RadioGroup: the radios inside share its groupValue; choosing one runs its changed reactions.

Written `radioGroup={…}` on any line ([RadioGroupBehavior](#type-RadioGroupBehavior)). Level 1.
 Each field of its record (RadioGroupBehavior) is a key of its own, dotted: `radioGroup.groupValue=…`.

<a id="type-RadioGroupBehavior"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radioGroup.groupValue` | text | `""` | The value of the radio that is on; bind it to the variable the choice is kept in. |

<a id="forms-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onChange`](events.md#trigger-changed), [`onChangeEnd`](events.md#trigger-changeEnd), [`onSubmit`](events.md#trigger-submitted), [`onDeleted`](events.md#trigger-deleted), [`onEditingComplete`](events.md#trigger-editingComplete), [`onFocus`](events.md#trigger-focusGained), [`onBlur`](events.md#trigger-focusLost), [`onKeyDown`](events.md#trigger-keyDown), [`onKeyUp`](events.md#trigger-keyUp).
- Actions: [`editText`](events.md#action-editText), [`focus`](events.md#action-focus), [`validate`](events.md#action-validate).

<a id="forms-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-InputDecoration"></a>
### InputDecoration

Flutter's `InputDecoration`: a text field's border, label, hint, helper, error, prefix and suffix. Every field has Flutter's default (unset: the theme's).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | [InputIcon](#type-InputIcon) |  | An icon before the field, outside its border. |
| `labelText` | text |  | The label: inside the empty field, floating above it when focused or filled. |
| `labelStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The label's style. |
| `floatingLabelStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The label's style when it floats above the field. |
| `helperText` | text |  | A line of help under the field. |
| `helperStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The helper text's style. |
| `helperMaxLines` | whole number |  | At most this many lines of helper text. |
| `hintText` | text |  | Shown in the empty field (a placeholder). |
| `hintStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The hint's style. |
| `hintMaxLines` | whole number |  | At most this many lines of hint. |
| `errorText` | text |  | The error under the field. Bound to a yes/no (SDK 8.x's error switch), `true` puts the field in error without a message (`kErrorWithoutMessage`: the error border only) and `false` clears it. |
| `errorStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The error text's style. |
| `errorMaxLines` | whole number |  | At most this many lines of error text. |
| `floatingLabelBehavior` | `never` `auto` `always` |  | When the label floats above the field: `auto`, `always`, `never`. |
| `isCollapsed` | `true`/`false` | `false` | No padding and no room for a label: the field is as small as its text. |
| `isDense` | `true`/`false` |  | Less vertical padding. |
| `contentPadding` | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) |  | Space between the border and the text: a number or `[left, top, right, bottom]`. An outlined field needs some (`[14, 16, 14, 16]`) to keep the text off the border. |
| `prefixIcon` | [InputIcon](#type-InputIcon) |  | An icon inside the border, before the text: `{"icon": "search", "size": 18}`; it may take reactions. |
| `prefixIconConstraints` | [BoxConstraints](values.md#type-BoxConstraints) | `{}` | The prefix icon's size limits. |
| `prefixText` | text |  | Text before the typed text (`$`). |
| `prefixStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The prefix text's style. |
| `suffixIcon` | [InputIcon](#type-InputIcon) |  | An icon inside the border, after the text: a clear (`close`) or show-password button; it may take reactions. |
| `suffixIconConstraints` | [BoxConstraints](values.md#type-BoxConstraints) | `{}` | The suffix icon's size limits. |
| `suffixText` | text |  | Text after the typed text (`kg`). |
| `suffixStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The suffix text's style. |
| `counterText` | text |  | Replaces the character counter; `""` hides it. |
| `counterStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The character counter's style. |
| `filled` | `true`/`false` |  | Paints `fillColor` behind the field. |
| `fillColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The field's background, drawn when `filled` is true. |
| `focusColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The fill while the field has the focus. |
| `hoverColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The fill while a mouse is over the field. |
| `errorBorder` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border while the field shows an error (`errorText` set). |
| `focusedBorder` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border while the field has the focus. |
| `focusedErrorBorder` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border while the field has the focus and shows an error. |
| `disabledBorder` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border while the field is disabled. |
| `enabledBorder` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border while the field is enabled and not focused. |
| `border` | [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder) |  | The border used for any state without its own (`{"type": "outline", "borderSide": {...}, "borderRadius": 8}`, `underline` or `none`). |
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` | False draws the field disabled. |
| `semanticCounterText` | text |  | What a screen reader says for the counter. |
| `alignLabelWithHint` | `true`/`false` |  | Aligns the label with the hint in a multi-line field. |
| `constraints` | [BoxConstraints](values.md#type-BoxConstraints) | `{}` | Size limits for the decorated field. |
| `prefixIconPadding` | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) |  | Space around the prefix icon inside its box: places it at a set inset instead of Material's centered 48 px box; null keeps Material's layout. |
| `suffixIconPadding` | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) |  | Space around the suffix icon inside its box; see `prefixIconPadding`. |
| `affixesAlwaysVisible` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Shows `prefixText` and `suffixText` all the time, not only once the field is focused or has text (a unit such as "kWh"). |
| `paddingIncludesBorder` | `true`/`false` | `false` | The active border's width adds to `contentPadding`, as a container's border adds to its padding (Flutter draws an outline over the padding). |

<a id="type-InputBorder"></a>
### InputBorder

Flutter's `InputBorder`: an `OutlineInputBorder` (the default here), an `UnderlineInputBorder` or `InputBorder.none`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `none` `outline` `underline` | `outline` | `outline` (a box), `underline` (a line under the text) or `none`. |
| `borderSide` | [BorderSide](decoration.md#type-BorderSide) | `{}` | The line: its color and width. |
| `borderRadius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `4` | The corners' radius. |
| `gapPadding` | number (≥ 0) | `4` | The gap around a floating label in an outline border. |

<a id="type-InputIcon"></a>
### InputIcon

An icon an input shows (`Icon`): a glyph as the icon node's `icon` prop (`{"source", "name", "codepoint", ...}` or an image), its size and color, and the actions a tap on it runs.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` | The glyph, written as the `icon` node's `props.icon`: a Material icon name (`"search"`) or `{"type": "MATERIAL_ICON", "name": "search"}`. |
| `size` | number (≥ 0) | `24` | The glyph's size. |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The glyph's color. |
| `actions` | list of JSON | `[]` | Reactions, as a node's: a tap on the icon (`{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [...]}`). |

<a id="type-ButtonStyle"></a>
### ButtonStyle

Flutter's `ButtonStyle`, as the buttons' `styleFrom` takes it. Null fields are the button's own defaults. The padding is the node's `layout.padding`; the size is the node's box (no minimum size).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The button's fill. |
| `foregroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Label (and icon) color. |
| `shadowColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The color of the shadow under a raised button. |
| `elevation` | number |  | How raised the button is (its shadow). |
| `textStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | The label's style (a TextStyle or a theme style's name). Its color comes from `foregroundColor`; without a `fontSize` the label is 12 px. |
| `side` | [BorderSide](decoration.md#type-BorderSide) |  | The button's border. |
| `shape` | [ShapeBorder](#type-ShapeBorder) |  | The button's shape: `{"type": "roundedRectangle", "borderRadius": 10}`, `stadium`, `circle`... |
| `iconSize` | number |  | The icon's size. |
| `iconColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The icon's color; without one, `foregroundColor`. |

<a id="type-ShapeBorder"></a>
### ShapeBorder

One of Flutter's `OutlinedBorder`s: its kind, corner radius and side. JSON: `{"type": "stadium", "borderRadius": 8, "side": {...}}`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `roundedRectangle` `circle` `stadium` `continuousRectangle` `beveledRectangle` `roundedSuperellipse` | `roundedRectangle` |  |
| `borderRadius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` | Corner radii (rectangle types). |
| `side` | [BorderSide](decoration.md#type-BorderSide) |  | The outline; null draws none. |

<a id="type-ButtonSegment"></a>
### ButtonSegment

Flutter's `ButtonSegment<String>`: one segment of a segmented button.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | text | `""` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `icon` | [InputIcon](#type-InputIcon) |  |  |
| `tooltip` | text |  |  |
| `enabled` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |

<a id="type-IconAction"></a>
### IconAction

An icon with its own size, color and tooltip: an app bar's leading icon or action (Flutter's `IconButton` in `AppBar.actions`). `actions` are its reactions, as a node's.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` |  |
| `size` | number |  |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `tooltip` | text |  |  |
| `actions` | list of JSON | `[]` |  |

<a id="forms-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="forms-example-form-json"></a>
### form.json

From [`form.json`](../forms.md).

```notation
state email=""
state tried=false
state sent=false
canvas h=500
Column#col gap=8 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":500}
  Input#email "Email" hint="you@example.com" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":28} keyboardType=emailAddress onChange={email="{result}"}
  Text#emailError "Enter a valid email address." color=#FFDC2626 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":18} visible={tried && !contains(email, '@')}
  Button.elevated#send "Send" w={"hug":120} h=44 onTap={tried="true"; if condition={"left":"${= contains(email, '@')}","op":"isTrue"} then={sent="true"}}
  Text#thanks "Thanks! We'll reply within a day." size=15 color=#FF16A34A w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20} visible={sent}
```

<a id="forms-example-form-validated-json"></a>
### form_validated.json

From [`form_validated.json`](../forms.md).

```notation
state name=""
state email=""
state budget="small"
state message=""
state sent=false
canvas h=760
Column#page scroll pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":760}
  Column#contactForm gap=14 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":560} visible={!sent} form.autovalidateMode=onUnfocus
    Column#summary gap=4 pad=12 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":60} fill=#FFFEF2F2 border=#FFDC2626 radius=8 visible={length(form.errors) > 0}
      Text.success#summaryTitle "" size=15 color=#FF991B1B w={"fill":318} h={"hug":20} text={length(form.errors) + (length(form.errors) == 1 ? ' field needs' : ' fields need') + ' attention'}
      ListView#summaryList w={"fill":318} h={"hug":40} scrollable=false gap=2
        each item in form.errors
          Text#summaryItem "{item.label}: {item.message}" color=#FF991B1B w={"fill":318} h={"hug":18}
    Input#name "Name" radius=8 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":56} initialValue={name} validator="${= trim(value) == '' ? 'Enter your name.' : ''}"
    Input#email "Email" radius=8 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":56} initialValue={email} keyboardType=emailAddress validator="${= trim(value) == '' ? 'Enter your email.' : !matches(value, '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+[.][^@ ]+$') ? 'Enter an email like name@example.com.' : ''}"
    Text.heading#budgetLabel "Budget" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20}
    Row#budget gap=8 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":32} radioGroup.groupValue={budget} crossAxisAlignment=null node.radioGroup.groupValue=small onChange={budget="{result}"}
      Radio#budgetSmall w=24 h=24 value=small
      Text#budgetSmallLabel "Under $10k" size=14 color=#FF374151 w={"hug":90} h={"hug":20}
      Radio#budgetLarge w=24 h=24 value=large
      Text#budgetLargeLabel "$10k or more" size=14 color=#FF374151 w={"hug":90} h={"hug":20}
    Input#message "Message" radius=8 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":120} initialValue={message} decoration.alignLabelWithHint=true maxLines=5 minLines=3 validator="${= length(trim(value)) < 20 ? 'Tell us a little more (20 characters or more).' : ''}"
    Button#send "Send message" w={"fill":342} h=48 onTap={validate node=contactForm; if condition={"left":"${result}","op":"isTrue"} then={sent=true}}
  Column#thanks gap=6 pad=16 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":80} fill=#FFF0FDF4 radius=8 visible={sent}
    Text.heading3#thanksTitle "Thanks, {name}!" weight=700 color=#FF166534 w={"fill":310} h={"hug":24}
    Text#thanksBody "We'll reply to {email} within a day." size=14 color=#FF166534 w={"fill":310} h={"hug":20}
```

<a id="forms-example-form-offline-json"></a>
### form_offline.json

From [`form_offline.json`](../forms.md).

```notation
state email=""
state status="idle"
state failNext=false
canvas h=420
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":420} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Column#form gap=12 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":120} visible={status == 'idle' || status == 'error'} crossAxisAlignment=null form=true
    Input#email "Email" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":56} @email keyboardType=emailAddress validator="${= matches(value, '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+[.][^@ ]+$') ? '' : 'Enter an email like name@example.com.'}"
    Button#send "Subscribe" w={"fill":342} h=48 onTap={validate node=form; if condition={"left":"${result}","op":"isTrue"} then={status=sending; delay ms=900; if condition={"left":"${failNext}","op":"isTrue"} then={status=error} else={setStorage key=submissions op=insert valueType=list value={{'email': email, 'at': now()}}; emitEvent event=signupSubmitted props={"email":"${email}"}; status=sent}}}
  Row#sending gap=10 w={"fill":342} h=32 visible={status == 'sending'} crossAxisAlignment=null
    CircularProgressIndicator#spinner w=24 h=24
    Text#sendingText "Sending…" size=15 color=#FF334155 w={"fill":300} h={"hug":20}
  Text#failed "We couldn't send that. Try again." size=15 color=#FFDC2626 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20} visible={status == 'error'}
  Text#sent "Saved on this device: {email}. Nothing is sent." size=15 color=#FF166534 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20} visible={status == 'sent'}
```
